title: The functional β ↦ ζ(β∧α) is represented by V = Σ_l ζ(e_l♭∧α)e_l, and V ∈ Q when ζ orients Q
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let ζ ∈ Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P) = MultiVector P (n+1) (a continuous linear functional on (n+1)-covectors) and let α ∈ Λⁿ(ℝ^P) = Covector (Euclid P) n. For a 1-covector β : ℝ^P →L[ℝ] ℝ write β∧α := alternatizeUncurryFin(β.smulRight α), so that (β∧α)(v_0, …, v_n) = Σ_{i=0}^{n} (−1)^i·β(v_i)·α(v_0, …, v̂_i, …, v_n). Let e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 (l ∈ Fin P) be the standard basis, e_l♭ := innerSL ℝ e_l = ⟨e_l, ·⟩, and V := Σ_l ζ(e_l♭∧α)·e_l ∈ ℝ^P. Then (1) ζ(β∧α) = β(V) for every 1-covector β; and (2) V ∈ Q for every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P of which ζ is a unit orientation (IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ζ : MultiVector P (n + 1)) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), (∀ β : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin (β.smulRight α)) = β (∑ l : Fin P, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))).smulRight α)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) ∧ ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), IsUnitOrientationOf ζ Q → (∑ l : Fin P, ζ (ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((innerSL ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))).smulRight α)) • EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ)) ∈ Q
